shipped_now.not_indexed: Hindi train (~3.7GB / ~808k queries), Marathi, and the other 12 languages. Full dump is 55.6GB / 11.4M rows.

verdict: 12k was not acceptable: only 21% of unique selected Hindi-val passages, so in-index recall hid coverage holes (e.g. भारत की राजधानी abstained because the gold passage was not in the slice). The shipped index is now every unique selected Hindi-val passage (57,331). That is still not the whole 14-language 55GB dump — train and the other languages are not on disk and are not claimed.
note: The brief names the dataset, not a required row count. Indexing 55GB is a download, not a system.
